subject: R7 economics instrumentation aligned to R10 transaction architecture
body: R7 reviewed R10 transaction-adapter architecture v0.1 and recommends one combined event architecture rather than a separate economics state machine. R10 transaction_id should be the lifecycle cost denominator, operation_id the logical-mutation unit, and attempt_id the transport-cost unit. Multiple transport attempts must increase cost without creating extra booking denominators. CONFIRMED_BOOKED is the only R10 transaction state that should increment authoritative confirmed-booking metrics. RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED and HUMAN_RECOVERY_REQUIRED must be first-class economic events with active human time and reason codes. Calendar projection cost should be reported separately and must not affect booking-confirmation rate. R7 also recommends a versioned cost-rate catalog outside immutable transaction events and adding R10 identifiers/state transitions to the economics event schema. This alignment avoids duplicate state machines, denominator drift, and hidden reconciliation labour.
evidence: BenefitFlow R10 — Integration and Transaction Adapter Architecture v0.1
